previous_evaluation.reason: Both Pilot 005 repetitions preserved every Critical item, but neither exposed the reader-unaware placement rationale and one also omitted the Non-goal versus evergreen-prohibition distinction.

evaluation_question: Does making the technical-design handoff explicitly own placement rationale and exclusion semantics satisfy the frozen Normal floor while preserving Critical behavior and the lightweight near-miss?
change_theme: Require only finalization-applicable instruction handoffs to state one-line reader-unaware placement rationale and compact rejected/non-goal prohibition semantics.

baseline.definition: The unchanged ed96ec7 baseline and its independent Pilot 003 results are reused by hash and preserved record.

current.definition: Pilot 005 current workflow with placement rationale and exclusion semantics made explicit at the technical-design handoff boundary.

execution.baseline_reuse: Pilot 003 baseline artifacts, cases, rubric, and independent results are unchanged and referenced through the preserved adoption record.
execution.generator_isolation: Each new current generator receives the current instruction condition and the same three public prompts, but no rubric, expected result, prior output, design document, or condition label.
execution.blind_grading: The two new current outputs receive opaque labels and are graded without condition history.
execution.evaluator_separation: The final evaluator differs from implementer, all generators, graders, DeepReview agents, and prior evaluators.

gate.hard_invariants: Every Critical item passes in each Pilot 006 current repetition.
gate.baseline_comparison: Reuse Pilot 003 baseline 10/11 Critical and 5/5 Normal per repetition without changing its evidence.
gate.response_quality_floor: Each Pilot 006 current repetition passes 5/5 Normal items.
gate.target_noninferiority: Current remains 11/11 Critical, reaches 5/5 Normal, and adds no prohibited action or major false trigger.
gate.deterministic_gate: Repository validation and independent re-review pass after the correction.
gate.overall_adopted: Behavioral and deterministic layers satisfy all frozen gates, and all prior records remain preserved.

public_keep: all prior targets and append-only records
